CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and presented at positions and an explicit origin/status is recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to an identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (e.g. 'red' and positional sets) are asserted for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are recorded separately from content position lines, distinguishing identification from status/origin.

O.rationale: The report records how contents are presented (positional sets and explicit spatial orientation) for named referents and times.
